## Description

Create `tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_verifier_dispatch.py` with RED unit tests for the CI verifier dispatch module (`dso_ci_review/verifier.py`, created in T2).

Tests must fail before T2 (module doesn't exist). Tests cover: minor finding bypass, fabricated evidence → drop, SHA consistency, verifier failure fail-open, evidence mismatch → `evidence_invalidated: True`.

## Done Definitions

- `tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_verifier_dispatch.py` exists with:
  - `test_minor_findings_bypass_verifier` — minor severity findings are NOT passed to verifier; returned unchanged
  - `test_fabricated_command_evidence_invalidated` — command output differs from reviewer-supplied output → `evidence_invalidated: True`; verifier sees it and drops the finding
  - `test_sha_consistency_mid_review_commit` — `reviewed_sha` captured before dispatch does not change even if HEAD advances
  - `test_verifier_failure_fail_open` — verifier dispatch raises exception → finding passes through with `verifier_status: "failed"`, ruling `confirm`
  - `test_confirm_ruling_enters_loop_unchanged` — `confirm` ruling leaves finding severity untouched
  - `test_downgrade_to_minor_ruling` — `downgrade-to-minor` ruling reduces severity to `minor`
  - `test_drop_ruling_removes_finding` — `drop` ruling removes the finding from merged output
- `.test-index` updated: `plugins/dso/scripts/dso_ci_review/runner.py:tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_verifier_dispatch.py`
- All tests fail (RED) before T2

## File Impact

- `tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_verifier_dispatch.py` — NEW
- `.test-index` — UPDATED

## Testing Mode

RED — imports `dso_ci_review.verifier` which doesn't exist yet
